# IKON Dental Group

> IKON Dental Group provides comprehensive preventative, restorative, and cosmetic dental services across Plainville, Bristol, and Berlin, Connecticut.

IKON Dental Group, led by Dr. Izaz Khan, offers a full range of dental services from routine cleanings and exams to advanced restorative treatments like dental implants and crowns. The practice serves multiple Connecticut locations and emphasizes patient education through detailed guides on preventative care, gum disease management, and tooth replacement options.

## Key Topics

- Dental implants
- Preventative care
- Restorative dentistry
- Gum disease treatment
- Dental crowns
- Teeth cleaning
- Oral cancer screening
- Dr. Izaz Khan
- Plainville & Bristol, CT
- Digital imaging
- Tooth-colored fillings
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Dentures

## Core Services

- [IKON Dental Group](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com): IKON Dental Group homepage showcasing comprehensive dental services in Plainville and Bristol, CT.
- [Preventative Dental Care](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative-care): Main preventative care services page covering cleanings, exams, and oral health maintenance.
- [Restorative Dental Care](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative): Main restorative dentistry page covering implants, crowns, dentures, and tooth fillings.

## Preventative Care Services

- [Comprehensive Dental Exam](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/comprehensive-exam): Guide to comprehensive dental exams with Dr. Khan for cavity and disease detection.
- [Dental Emergencies](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/dental-emergencies): First aid guide for dental emergencies including tooth injuries and emergency care.
- [Teeth Cleaning](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/teeth-cleaning): Educational content on professional teeth cleaning and oral hygiene maintenance.
- [Gum Disease](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/gum-disease): Comprehensive guide to gum disease symptoms, causes, and treatment options.
- [Scaling & Root Planing](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/scaling-and-root-planing): Treatment guide for scaling and root planing procedures for gum disease management.
- [Oral Cancer Screening](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/oral-cancer-screening): Educational guide on oral cancer screening procedures and early detection with Dr. Khan.
- [Digital Radiographs](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/digital-radiographs): Information on digital X-ray technology and radiation safety in dental diagnosis.
- [Digital and Intraoral Photographs](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/digital-and-intraoral-photographs): Guide to digital photography techniques used for dental diagnosis and patient education.
- [Children's Dentistry](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/preventative/childrens-dentistry): Pediatric dental care guide covering baby teeth, cavity prevention, and sealants.

## Restorative & Tooth Replacement

- [Dental Implants](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/dental-implants): Comprehensive patient education on dental implant procedures and tooth replacement.
- [Dental Crowns](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/dental-crowns): Treatment guide covering dental crown types, procedures, and cosmetic benefits.
- [Dental Implant Restorations](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/dental-implant-restorations): Educational content on dental implant restoration procedures and surgical options.
- [Complete and Partial Dentures](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/complete-and-partial-dentures): Patient guide to complete and partial dentures, care, and treatment processes.
- [Dental Bridges](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/dental-bridges): Guide to dental bridges for missing tooth replacement and bite restoration.
- [Tooth-Colored Fillings](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/tooth-colored-fillings): Guide to tooth-colored filling procedures as an alternative to amalgam restorations.
- [Inlays & Onlays](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/inlays-and-onlays): Patient guide to inlays and onlays for cavity treatment and tooth restoration.
- [Dental Extractions](https://www.ikondentalgroup.com/restorative/dental-extractions): Guide to tooth extraction procedures, aftercare, and wisdom teeth removal.
